newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt recognises Zaire leadership change.
newsitem.headline: Egypt recognises Zaire leadership change.

text.p: Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said on Thursday that his country recognised the change in leadership in Zaire and would pursue ties with the country.
He made the remarks to reporters.

Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila changed the name of Zaire to the Democratic Republic of Congo after his rebels took over the country at the weekend. The composition of the new government was due to be announced on Thursday night.
